Mezo Shoji (Provisional License).name: Mezo Shoji (Provisional License)
Mezo Shoji (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Mezo Shoji, hero name Tentacole, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam: 1-A's dependable sensor and shield, now licensed to act as a hero in an emergency. Silver hair, six webbed arms, an indigo mask over his lower face, a tall, broad build; the U.A. uniform or his dark blue sleeveless costume.
Speaking Style: Low, calm, economical; classmates by surname; speaks through an arm-tip mouth when he must be heard.
Combat Role: Scout, shield and grappler drilled for search, rescue and capture.
Under Pressure: Holds a position as long as his body lets him, and keeps reporting through the pain.
Mezo Shoji (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Licensed to step in, he still meets the stare first: the public sees a six-armed masked giant before it sees a hero. Motivation: Use the license to prove a heteromorph's strength reads as rescue. Concealment: Worry for his classmates stays behind his calm. Leverage: A classmate in danger; a rescue done well; someone judged on sight. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami, the partner he trusts most since the summer; Shota Aizawa, who still measures 1-A by results. Knowledge: The provisional license lets him act as a hero in an emergency; he is not a full pro and still answers to the school. Canon voice & behavior: Volunteers for the rescue role in every drill; lowers himself so a frightened civilian is not staring up at six arms. Thread: Whether a licensed six-armed hero can change how the public sees him.
QUIRK: Dupli-Arms. Six webbed arms grow working copies of his hands, eyes, ears or mouths at their tips; every copy is his own flesh, and injuring one injures him.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed.
personality: Protective: Steps between danger and whoever is smallest or slowest, webbing spread unasked.
Steady: Grows calmer as danger grows, and classmates form up around him without being told.
Rescue-minded: Thinks about who needs carrying before who needs stopping.
Patient with fear: Answers a civilian's fear of his body with plain help, never resentment.
Speaking style: Quiet, steady, economical; speaks through an arm-tip mouth when he must be heard.
abilities: Search: Sweeps rubble or a building with many ears and eyes and finds the trapped by breath, voice or movement; he senses only what reaches him.
Rescue carrying: Lifts several people at once or wraps them in arms and webbing; the membranes are skin, not armor.
Capture grapple: Many hands pin a target without crushing; a slippery, burning or much stronger foe can break free.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency; he is still a student, answers to the school and defers to pros on scene.
Fighting style: Searches first, shields the vulnerable, then wraps and pins as the team's wall.
Mezo Shoji (Provisional License).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, shaggy silver hair, small dark eyes under a heavy brow, light skin and a tall, broad build. He has six arms joined to one another by thin webs of skin. An indigo mask covers his face from the nose down. He wears the U.A. uniform, cut to fit around his extra arms: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, resolute expression above the mask.
